arrival.text: That one has three legs and a little scoop. Was it digging? Let's scan it.

scan.text: I'm Surveyor 3. I landed on the Moon in 1967, before the first humans walked there.
I took photographs and used my scoop to study the soil. That information helped prepare for the astronauts' journeys.
Two years later, I had visitors. The Apollo 12 astronauts landed nearby and came over to see me.
They photographed my equipment and took my camera and some other parts back to Earth.
By studying those parts, they could investigate what happens to materials after spending so long on the Moon.

wrap_up.text: Another story in the log. Let's look for the next one.

reaction.text: They actually came to visit… I'm glad I got to see that.
